column1: Mr. GAURANG V. SONI - EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR (48)
Mr. Gaurang Soni is the Director of Delta Automobiles Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of
Nairobi Business Ventures PLC. He is the Director of Operations at Shreeji enterprises Limited,
one of the biggest logistics companies in Kenya with a fleet size of more than 700 trucks, operating
in East African Region and beyond. He has been associated with the Shreeji Group Companies for
over 22 years in various roles. He is an expert in logistics operations. (Appointed July 2022)
